nodes.label: Mascot Artwork Drag Surface
nodes.rationale: The artwork is the direct drag surface; only navigation controls are excluded so clicking them cycles without beginning a drag.

nodes.label: Mascot Navigation Controls
nodes.rationale: Previous and next controls make mascot choices discoverable without a popover competing with the adjacent voice picker.

nodes.label: Session-local Mascot Positioning
nodes.rationale: Before a completed drag the viewport companion is positioned by the Voiceovers landmark on wide screens and by the viewport lower-left on narrow screens; its clamped position lasts for the open tab.
